name: CSV Importer
project_description:
The module provides a powerful and flexible solution for importing data from CSV files into Drupal. Designed to handle various use cases, it allows administrators to map CSV columns to entity fields seamlessly, enabling the bulk creation or updating of content, users, or other entities. With support for large datasets, the module simplifies data migration and ensures efficient integration with your Drupal site.

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 
 Navigate to - /admin/content/csv-importer 
 Select entity type, bundle, delimiter 
 Make sure that the file is in the UTF-8 format 
 Select the file 
 Press import 
 
 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Import content 
 Import content for multiple field 
 Import files 
 Import translations 
 Rollback/Undo import 
 
 For more details and examples see documentation
